note: Breadth questions for Biology and Chemistry Environments (P4), two per topic. Written by hand for this repo; not taken from any textbook. Changing this file is a declared amendment (hard constraint 9): update eval/golden/breadth.sha256 and say why in the changelog.

questions.question: How much is a cell magnified in my drawing?
What is magnification and how do I calculate it from the image size and the actual size?
Why are cells so small? Does surface area to volume ratio matter?
In the agar cube experiment, how does the size of the cube change how fast things diffuse in?
What is the compensation point of a leaf and how does light intensity affect photosynthesis?
How does the rate of photosynthesis change as light intensity increases?
How many moles are in 36 g of water?
How do I convert the mass of a substance to moles using its molar mass?
How do I find the concentration of sodium hydroxide from a titration with hydrochloric acid?
What happens to the concentration when I dilute a solution with water?
How do I calculate the heat released in the neutralisation of an acid by an alkali?
How do I use the temperature rise to find the heat of neutralisation?
How do I find the average rate of a reaction from the gas collected?
How does the time taken to collect gas change the rate of reaction?
